verdicts.reason: A breaks the text block apart: the headline, subline and CTA sit far apart with big uneven gaps, the CTA is pushed right so it doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, the NEW badge floats alone in the top-right corner away from the product, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the headline and subline together and makes the jar large enough to hold the left half, but the headline is still tiny next to the 'LUMEN & FIG' label on the jar, so the label outranks it. The NEW badge is also cut off from the product, and the CTA sits roughly on a centre axis that doesn't match the text's left edge.
